release.name: MultiOmics 1.1.1
release.sourceIdentity: The immutable patch-release identity is the final merged 1.1.1 commit recorded by the v1.1.1 Git tag/GitHub Release; release/v1.1.0 remains the frozen 1.1.0 source line.

releaseType: post-Research-v1 ecosystem-coherence and reproducibility hardening patch
postV1Hardening: fail-closed structural exchange versus PK-readiness distinction
current Omics2PK independent consumer contract including mapped/transposed input and temporal metadata
DESeq2 whole-study global-null tail diagnostic without changing production inference
independent Sacurine xcms versus OpenMS feature-coordinate comparator with no post-hoc concordance threshold
shared Ecosystem navigation and graphical abstract across PMx Explain, MultiOmics and Omics2PK
deterministic normalization of MOFA2 Basilisk bootstrap tooling before the existing full Python-environment audit
requiredReleaseChecks: Research v1 version, evidence and scientific-boundary contract
survival::coxph numerical reference, PH diagnostics and refusal controls
Omics2PK consumer contract - native MultiOmics synthetic ZIP
Independent Sacurine xcms versus OpenMS feature-coordinate comparator

knownOpenScientificLimitations.effect: Native DESeq2 output is reproducible but no universal nominal 5% FDR guarantee is claimed for arbitrary study designs.

knownOpenScientificLimitations.topic: LC-MS analytical validation beyond independent preprocessing execution
knownOpenScientificLimitations.effect: Independent xcms/OpenMS execution does not establish chemical identity, quantitative accuracy, universal feature-QC policy or interlaboratory validation.

knownOpenScientificLimitations.topic: Transferable individual biological signatures for Omics2PK
knownOpenScientificLimitations.effect: Schema-valid individual scores are not automatically biologically validated PK/PD covariates.

deploymentBoundary: The public PMx-hosted /multiomics/ route must pin the exact qualified MultiOmics 1.1.1 commit; merging MultiOmics alone does not update the public site.
releaseBoundary: MultiOmics 1.1.1 is an ecosystem-coherence and reproducibility-hardening patch over the qualified 1.1.0 scientific line. It preserves analysis methods, software/provenance/interoperability behavior and explicit scientific limitations, and does not certify a user study, biomarker, PK benefit, causal mechanism or clinical use.
